from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document in the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
